# Files Replica

Files Replica is an experimental, independent macOS implementation of a limited folder-rule workflow. It is a partial recreation informed by the official Hazel manual, not a Hazel product, complete clone, or claim of full parity. The current public repository contains source only; it does not publish a downloadable app binary.

- [License](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files-replica/blob/main/LICENSE)

The neutral edition is built with `./scripts/build.sh`; `swift test --jobs 2` runs the checked-in test suite. These commands do not establish native workflow acceptance. See the testing and parity pages for evidence boundaries.

The separate [Pip Files project](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files) contains custom Pip variants and an older generic workflow edition. It is not this neutral Replica edition, and its edition claims should not be transferred here.
